research_question: Predicting year-round habitat suitability of four migratory baleen whale species in the Southern Ocean using dynamic species distribution models based on multi-source sighting data.

phase_1.user_prompt: We are fitting dynamic habitat-suitability models for baleen whales in the Southern Ocean and want to fold in the visual whale-sighting records collected from RV Polarstern and archived in PANGAEA. We need the sightings from four expedition legs specifically: ANT-XXIII/6, ANT-XXIII/7, ANT-XXVIII/4 and ANT-XXIX/2. Find the PANGAEA dataset that holds the whale sightings for each of those legs and give me the four dataset DOIs.

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have the DOIs for the RV Polarstern whale sightings (10.1594/PANGAEA.729034, 10.1594/PANGAEA.729035, 10.1594/PANGAEA.819863, and 10.1594/PANGAEA.819866), please retrieve the tabular data for these datasets so we can merge them into our larger species sighting database for the habitat suitability models.
